scope:
Package K1c-3b (WEB + e2e + report refresh): the button 'Pokaz w grafie' in the sheet 'Co wyslalismy' must WORK now that the kernel draws the record of a request (K1c-2 + K1c-3a, both on this branch; HEAD 07988cce (gate k1c3a green) or later - read `git log --oneline -8`). Read docs/reports/INDEX.md sections 'S1 / M1-K1c2' and 'S1 / M1-K1c3a' (facts, decisions) first; nothing else of the docs.
FACTS. (1) loom/web/src/components/ContextReceipt.tsx ~lines 66-76 PROBES the kernel: actions.graphNavigate({focus:'msg:<request>', perspectives:['sent_to_model'], hops:1, limit:1, lang}) - an answer enables the button (state 'yes'), a refusal is shown as the reason of the disabled button (receipt-show-in-graph-reason). Before K1c-3a the kernel refused; now it answers, so the button enables by itself. Tapping it calls onShowInGraph('msg:<request>', ['sent_to_model']) -> App.tsx openNavigator(focus, perspectives) -> GraphNavigator (loom/web/src/components/GraphNavigator.tsx, prop initialPerspectives, data-perspectives, testids graph-navigator / nav-perspectives / nav-empty). (2) The kernel's navigate answer for this perspective (K1c-3a): rows as before PLUS on edges `weight` (tokens for sent_to_model, 1 or count for left_out_of_model), `metadata` {class, section, why, source_kind, ref, tokens_est | group, reason, reason_human, group_count}, `derived`; on node rows `derived`, `derived_note` (pl/en sentence: this node is a view of the record, not a stored node), `value`/`value_human` ('2 tokens (estimate)'), `receipt` {class, section, tokens_est, request}; on the answer a `receipt` summary {present, counts, sections, dropped[], note | missing_reason + text}, `handed_from` (when the focus was an answer message), counts.collapsed; derived addresses are sent:<request_msg_id>:<ref>; graph.card knows them (schema loom.graph_card/1, derived:true, relations.sent_to_model.in with weight). A focus that is not a message gives receipt.present:false, missing_reason 'focus_not_a_message' with a sentence. Real elements are msg:<id> / memory:<id> rows without `derived`. (3) SURPRISE, measured: the local gate k1c3a on 07988cce (K1c-3a included) was GREEN, and loom/web/e2e/m1-context-sent-native.mjs line ~143 ('Pokaz w grafie stays visible and disabled with its reason while the kernel has no source') still PASSED - so in the real server + browser the button is STILL disabled although the in-process kernel test of navigate passes. That step only checks that `data-kernel-answer` is NON-EMPTY, so it cannot tell the reasons apart. FIRST find out what the answer actually is (print the attribute): candidates - the harness mounts ChatView without onShowInGraph (state 'no_navigator'); the probe's POST /api/graph/navigate is refused or loses `perspectives`/`focus` on the HTTP path (see StepOutcome graph_navigate in loom/src/actions/ops.cpp ~line 2134, focus_of, the web transport loom/web/src/api/loom-http.ts line ~115); the answer differs for limit:1/hops:1; the language/effective-view of the server differs from the unit test. Fix the layer that is wrong: web wiring first; a MINIMAL kernel/server fix is allowed here if the HTTP path is the cause (with a test; say so in the card), otherwise kernel code stays untouched. Then that old step must be REPLACED by the real flow below.
WHAT TO BUILD, commit after each piece: (A) THE e2e FIRST: replace that step with the real flow (390x844 touch, the real loom-server + mock_llm_server.py, as the neighbours): open the sheet under an answer, the button 'Pokaz w grafie' is ENABLED (no reason line), tap it -> the navigator is open on the request (data-focus msg:<request>, data-perspectives 'sent_to_model') and lists the sent elements with their token weights, the left-out ones are visible and worded as left out (use a profile/option that drops something, e.g. the 'Zgodnosc' profile or a thread filter, as K1c-2's kernel test does) and the derived rows say in words that they are a view of the record; tap a derived row -> the card shows the derived_note and the tokens as an estimate; Back returns to the chat. Every expected string comes from the pack (conversation_view.pack words / kernel words returned in the answer), never a literal; wait for conditions, never read a text/attribute right after a tap if the UI sets it from an effect (timing rule; three CI failures came from it). A message WITHOUT a record (switch the receipt off as the existing step does) must still say 'brak sladu (zapisane przed M1)' and the button stays disabled with the reason - keep that step (it is the honest negative). (B) WEB: make GraphNavigator / the node card render what the kernel now returns for this perspective where it does not yet: weight shown as tokens (value_human), the derived mark and derived_note (pack words pl+en with the keys the neighbours use; the kernel sentence is shown verbatim when the answer carries it), left-out edges worded with reason_human, the answer's `receipt` summary note when the list is empty (missing_reason text), `handed_from` as one short line ('z odpowiedzi do jej zapytania'). Reuse the existing row/card components; no new route literal is expected (graph.navigate/graph.card exist) - if you add one run the registry chain (python3 loom/tools/gen_graph_interfaces.py -> python3 loom/src/model/gen_runtime_profiles.py (then --check) -> re-pin sha256 of graph/interfaces.pack in loom/data/data_domains.pack -> ctest -R 'graph_entry|kb_pack|kb_data_domains|runtime_profile|onboarding_pack|graph_proj'). Words live in loom/data/profiles/conversation_view.pack: regenerate loom/src/onboarding/builtin.inc and loom/web/src/onboarding/generated/conversation-view.json with gen_onboarding_pack.py (explicit chunk lengths - keep that) then python3 /home/user/chatadhd/tools/clang_inc_check.py loom/build/dev must stay all ok. Unit tests for the pure functions you add (next to the neighbours; npm script + the CI step list in .github/workflows/loom.yml; testids into docs/reports/M1_W0_TESTIDS.md the way test:testids-doc wants). rules_extra: Shared machine: never kill processes by name; record the pid/port of the e2e servers you start and kill only those. Do NOT run the full gate (S1 does). CACHE RULE: no single tool call longer than ~4 minutes - run builds, tests and e2e in the background and poll with short calls. One native build at a time (disk is small: use loom/build/dev of this worktree). Keep context small: grep and line ranges, never dump big files. Tests must not depend on speed or order (wait for conditions; no sleeps that race). Private data: synthetic data only; never read docs/exports or eval/real-holdout-key. Texts for the owner in plain Polish and English; nothing described as working that is only planned or only unit-tested.
